title: Internal Simulation State Log (ISSL) v1
description: Formalism-agnostic JSON-LD checkpoint format emitted by OISA-compliant models at each GSimT checkpoint. Section inventory follows the OISA paper (IEEE BIBM 2026), Table II.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. Optional for schema validation but required for semantic annotation.

model_id.description: Stable identifier for the model node (e.g. 'miao2010_ode').

model_version.description: Traceable, immutable model-artefact identifier. Examples: 'BIOMD0000000546' (BioModels accession) or 'github:covid-tissue-models@5b7e42c+OISA_bridge' (commit-pinned fork).

sim_time_s.description: Simulation time (seconds) AFTER the step completes — i.e. the clock value at which the emitted state is valid.

formalism.description: Formalism tag. Orchestrator components read this before processing outputs.

schema_uri.description: URI of this ISSL schema (relative or absolute). Used by the orchestrator ISSL-ingestion component.

agent_count.description: Optional — ABM-only: total live agent count at checkpoint.

continuous_state.description: Running entity populations. Counts are biologically scaled (independent of source formalism).

count.description: Biologically scaled value in the declared unit.

ci_95.description: Uncertainty bounds: [lower, upper]. For stochastic models with ensemble size N, with N < 20 these correspond to sample min/max (ensemble range), not stable 2.5/97.5-percentile estimates — see paper §V-A.

discrete_events.description: Punctual events (cell death, cytokine peaks, etc.).

event_type.description: Term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. OBO) or a wildcard_namespace prefix.

n_realisations.description: ABM-only: number of independent realisations producing this event in the current tick.

export_signals.description: Inter-compartmental signals available for routing to other models. 'signal_id' is the orchestrator's routing key.

transfer_lag_s.description: Optional per-signal delay (seconds). When non-null the orchestrator's SignalQueue defers injection until the specified delay elapses. A lightweight transfer model on the edge may compute this dynamically; otherwise a constant is declared in the configuration graph.

internal_parameters.description: Kinetic / model parameter values with provenance.

provenance.description: DOI or database URI linking to the calibration source (e.g. a PROV-O URI or a BioModels accession).

watchdog.description: Model health signal consumed by the orchestrator's watchdog monitor.

divergence_score.description: Orchestrator pauses the model when divergence_score > 0.15.

next_checkpoint_s.description: Simulation-time of the next scheduled checkpoint.
